Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Caspian is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of items before we issue the PO:

1) We plan to use a weekly retainer lane for early months while usage ramps. Can Redwood accept a weekly invoice sweep (every Friday) instead of a single monthly invoice?

2) Our legal team will add a 10% holdback on activation-related line items until the first 30 days of uptime acceptance. Will the holdback requirement block PO activation or can Redwood use a separate "activation acceptance" ledger tag so we can invoice the rest immediately?

I've attached our standard PO template for reference. If it's helpful, I can loop AP (payments+ap) to coordinate the net terms — we typically default to Net45 for vendors of this tier.

Hi Megan — thanks for sending the template and context. Quick answers up front:

- Weekly sweep: We can support weekly invoicing, but we need to align on the invoice ID/PO mapping so our billing system aggregates token usage correctly. Weekly invoices are fine if the PO includes a recurring "retainer" SKU or a PO-line that maps to weekly frequency.

- Holdback: We can honor a 10% holdback on activation line items. To avoid delaying activation, we propose:
  * Redwood issues two invoice lines for the activation deliverable: "Activation (90% payable)" and "Activation holdback (10%)."
  * Holdback will be tagged with ledger code ACT-HDBK and paid once the acceptance window closes (30 days).
  * Activation will still be flagged as "active" for provisioning once we receive the PO + signed SOW.

I'll loop in Ben to confirm the invoice sample and the GL mapping required by our finance team. If Caspian can include the PO field CAS-PO-4931 and state "weekly sweep" under invoice cadence, that will make reconciliation much cleaner for both sides.

Evelyn
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

Thanks Megan / Evelyn — finance here. A few implementation notes so your AP can process without surprises:

1) PO fields: please ensure the PO includes these fields exactly: PO number, Billing entity (Redwood US, EIN: 12-3456789), Invoice cadence = WEEKLY, GL code field (optional), and PO effective date. We will match on PO number + invoice cadence when ingesting.

2) Invoice format: We'll accept CSV/XLSX or PDF. For weekly sweeps we prefer a single consolidated invoice per week referencing usage rows per day. That avoids 7 separate invoices.

3) Holdback tagging: Use the line item description "Activation — holdback (ACT-HDBK)". Payment run will include the 90% activation line; the 10% will be released after acceptance confirmation.

4) Net terms: Redwood accepts Net45 for this account. If Caspian requires Net60 as a standard, we can entertain Net60 with a 2% early payment discount if paid within 30 days — happy to put that in the SOW addendum.

If AP wants, I can send a short sample invoice with the PO-mapped headers and the weekly aggregation layout.

Thanks,
